title: 第23章 一只野鸡我要了第24章 林翠儿
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 王大山冷笑了一声。
他没犹豫，大步分开了人群，直接走到了女子面前。
“村我看也别在这难为情了。”
“要不这样吧。”
“反正我王大山如今年轻，家里也没个正经操持的婆娘。”
“她就不错，给我当婆娘待着，正合适。”
“这只野鸡，就当是我给的聘礼了。”
这话一出。
所有人都愣住了，用一种看疯子的眼神看着王大山。
跪在地上的老者猛的抬起头，脸上全是错愕。
他呆呆地看着肥硕的野鸡，又看了看面色平静的王大山。
似乎不敢相信自己的耳朵，嘴唇哆嗦了半天，才挤出一句话。
“小……小兄弟。”
“这是真的假的？”
“只要你能收下我女儿，给她条活路就行。”
“这野鸡……太贵重了，你收回去吧。”
他虽然饿得眼睛发绿，但还是存着几分良心。
在这荒年，一只野鸡那是能救命的东西，哪能随便拿来换个逃荒的丫头。
“说了这是聘礼，这就是聘礼。”
“我带你女儿回去，可不是让她去当奴婢干活的，那是去当老婆的。”
王大山没废话。
一把将野鸡，塞进了老者的怀里。
老者听完这话，比刚才还要惊讶。
他本来以为王大山只是见色起意，或者想找个便宜的劳力带回去。
没想到。
这个气势不凡的年轻人，竟然说要娶她。
老者活了大半辈子，看人的眼光还是有的。
眼前这后生，肩膀上扛着几百斤肉，手里拎着弓，一看就是有本事的大猎户。
自家女儿要是跟了他，别说活命了，说不定以后还能吃上肉。
“真的吗？”
“那太好了，老天爷开眼了。”
“翠儿，快，快跟这位小兄弟回家吧。”
“以后爹不在你身边了，你可得长点心。”
“要好好伺候人家，懂吗？”
在老者的催促下，女子怯生生的走上前，停在了王大山身边。
周围的村民们这时候终于回过神来了。
心里的平衡瞬间被打破了。
content_en:
Wang Dashan sneered.
He did not hesitate, strode away from the crowd, and walked directly to the woman.
"I think it's time to stop being embarrassed here."
"How about this."
"Anyway, I, Wang Dashan, am young now, and I don't have a decent mother-in-law in my family."
"She's not bad. She's just right to be my mother-in-law."
"This pheasant should be regarded as my betrothal gift."
…
As soon as these words came out.
Everyone was stunned and looked at Wang Dashan as if he were a madman.
The old man kneeling on the ground suddenly raised his head, his face full of astonishment.
He stared blankly at the plump pheasant, and then at Wang Dashan, who looked calm.
It seemed that he couldn't believe his ears, and his lips trembled for a long time before he managed to squeeze out a sentence.
"Little...little brother."
"Is this true or false?"
"As long as you can accept my daughter and give her a way to survive."
"This pheasant... is too valuable. Take it back."
Although his eyes were green from hunger, he still had some conscience.
In this famine year, a pheasant is a life-saving thing, how can it be casually exchanged for a girl fleeing the famine.
"I said this is the betrothal gift, and this is the betrothal gift."
"I took your daughter back not to work as a slave, but to be a wife."
Wang Dashan didn’t talk nonsense.
He stuffed the pheasant into the old man's arms.
…
After hearing this, the old man was even more surprised than before.
He originally thought that Wang Dashan was just interested in sex, or wanted to find cheap labor to take back.
Unexpectedly.
This impressive young man actually said he wanted to marry her.
The old man has lived for most of his life and still has a good eye for seeing people.
The young man in front of him, with hundreds of kilograms of meat on his shoulders and a bow in his hand, looked like a capable hunter.
If his daughter followed him, let alone survive, she might even be able to eat meat in the future.
"Really?"
"That's great, God's eyes are open."
"Tui'er, hurry up, come home with this little brother."
"Daddy won't be with you anymore, so you have to be more careful."
"You have to serve others well, understand?"
At the old man's urging, the woman timidly stepped forward and stopped next to Wang Dashan.
…
The surrounding villagers finally came to their senses at this time.
The balance in my heart was instantly broken.
